text: 金十数据10月16日讯，李强主持召开国务院常务会议，会议指出，人工智能是影响未来发展的关键变量，要从我国产业体系完备、应用场景丰富、工程化能力强等实际出发，注重以落地应用牵引技术创新，不断深化拓展“人工智能+”行动。要夯实发展底座，加强技术攻关和算法创新促进算电协同，增加高质量数据供给，着力补短板、锻长板。要突出赋能应用，以实体经济为重点强化供需衔接，鼓励联合研发，推进中试验证，加大场景培育力度，让人工智能技术更好转化为现实生产力。要统筹发展和安全，因业分级分类施策，加强风险研判评估，守牢人工智能安全底线。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 - Li Qiang presided over a State Council executive meeting. The meeting noted that artificial intelligence is a key variable affecting future development, and that starting from China's realities of a complete industrial system, rich application scenarios, and strong engineering capabilities, it is necessary to focus on driving technological innovation through implemented applications and continuously deepen and expand the "AI+" initiative. It is necessary to consolidate the development foundation, strengthen technological breakthroughs and algorithm innovation to promote computing-power coordination, increase the supply of high-quality data, and focus on shoring up weaknesses and forging strengths. It is necessary to highlight enabling applications, strengthen supply-demand alignment with the real economy as the focus, encourage joint research and development, advance pilot testing, and increase efforts to cultivate scenarios so that AI technology can be better transformed into real productivity. It is necessary to coordinate development and security, implement industry-specific tiered and categorized measures, strengthen risk assessment and evaluation, and firmly uphold the bottom line of AI security.
